title: Shared-service contact observation: physical B-opening and shunt invariance
status_authority: Whole supplied sources at their exact captured or introduced assumptions and source-read scope. Earlier immutable units and actual acceptance remain intact. No Capital scientific execution, reproof, source/artifact recovery, physical qualification or novelty audit.
reported_status: ROOT gives a conditional conductance-difference certificate after physically opening only diagnostic contact B while retaining the same part and functional A contact. A state-dependent shunt counterexample shows why that independent opening and shunt-change bound must be physically established. Existing Kelvin contactor constructions are credited at their own scope. No fixture, installed uncertainty, qualified microcontact or economical production system is supplied.
scientific_scope_status: ROOT gives a conditional conductance-difference certificate after physically opening only diagnostic contact B while retaining the same part and functional A contact. A state-dependent shunt counterexample shows why that independent opening and shunt-change bound must be physically established. Existing Kelvin contactor constructions are credited at their own scope. No fixture, installed uncertainty, qualified microcontact or economical production system is supplied. Same functional A path and part retained through an actual independent B opening. Closed/open conductance errors each<=e, actual unwanted-shunt change bounded by gamma, nonnegative series contributions and suitable installed current/compliance. Lead switching in software is not the physical intervention.

proof_availability.classification_scope: The certificate assumes invariant or independently bounded shunt conductance during B opening. Motion of contamination, A-load/frame changes or unverified conductor separation can violate it. Counterexamples concern the specified linear ports, not every sensor. Full paired-contact qualification, tooling, wear, service recovery and production advantage remain open.
